program_path.description: The full path to the executable command to run or control.

high_limit.description: Decimal value for the system load average threshold at which the child process is suspended.

low_limit.description: Decimal value for the system load average threshold at which the child process is resumed.

delay.description: Integral number of seconds between load average checks.

copies.description: Integer number of copies of the program to run.

socket_path.description: Path to create a UNIX domain socket file for use by lw-ctl. Empty string disables socket creation.

controlled_pid.description: The PID of an existing process to control. If 0, loadwatch spawns the program specified in program_path.
